name: ported_distance_axis_hv
_note: Axis-aligned (horizontal) conditional rim distance between two SEPARATED circles. cond [min,min] measures the facing near-rim gap: e1 right rim (x=10) to e2 left rim (x=cx2-6). Additive form |dx| - r0 - r1 - d: |cx2| - 10 - 6 - 20 = 0 -> cx2 = 36, so the facing gap is (36-6)-(0+10) = 20, exactly as SolidWorks would dimension it. This is the realistic, geometrically-unambiguous axis+cond case (the per-coordinate inside-the-abs form would instead report a same-side rim gap and is wrong here).
